metadata.coverage_rule: All recorded traffic-calming features, including removed and unknown statuses. Nearest traffic signals exclude RMVD. These are historical records, not active-asset counts.
metadata.limitation: Coverage is a straight-line distance from a school point, not walking distance or a measure of school safety, student exposure, or collisions.

cleaning_decisions: Schools were selected where PLACETYPE equals 500.
All non-school Places of Interest were kept as the comparison group.
Traffic-signal dates before 1900 were treated as placeholders.
